instruction: Adjust Chrome's startup settings so it opens the New Tab page rather than restoring tabs from last time.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks users to set Chrome to open a New Tab page on startup (fresh start mode). Similar difficulty to Do Not Track task - requires navigating to Chrome On startup settings. The evaluator checks the Chrome Preferences JSON file for 'session.restore_on_startup' field (value should be 5 for New Tab page, or the 'session' key should not exist for fresh start mode). Uses existing getter pattern from get_new_startup_page function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Chrome startup page setting from Preferences file
Logic correctly handles both cases: no 'session' key (fresh start) and restore_on_startup==5 (New Tab page)
Metric exact_match correctly compares result ('true'/'false') with expected value ('true')
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to verify persistent setting
Expected value 'true' semantically correct for New Tab page setting enabled
Data flow correct: getter returns string 'true'/'false', metric receives rules dict with 'expected' key, comparison works correctly
Edge cases handled: getter catches exceptions and handles missing keys
